resources.string: Select 2–8 overlapping photos in sweep order, with the same size and orientation. Supports a horizontal sweep with level, distant scenes. Rotation, perspective changes and moving subjects can cause seams. This is a flat panorama, not a 360° PhotoSphere.
Source-scale output: %1$d × %2$d px. Vertical borders are cropped to the shared image area.

Unable to align or save safely. Use ordered, overlapping, equally sized photos with detailed static scenes. Ambiguous overlap, excessive drift or insufficient memory is rejected; originals are preserved.
